item.title: COP31's draft deal asks the world to build 500 million tonnes of carbon capture by 2035
item.description: COP31's first draft deal asks countries to scale carbon capture to at least 500 million tonnes a year by 2035. The world runs about 68 million today. The EU and a bloc including Saudi Arabia and India want changes before talks close Nov 20.

item.title: Europe hands heavy industry more free carbon permits as COP31 enters its final week
item.description: EU governments and Parliament agreed on Nov 12 to give energy-intensive industry roughly 121 million more free carbon permits through 2030. Allowances traded near €90 a tonne, but a softer long-run price weakens the case for carbon capture and shifts cost to taxpayers.
